messages:
anya (oncall): Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need clear owners/timelines for rollout safety items. Who can own auto-rollback and blast-radius limits?

sam (platform): I can draft the auto-rollback policy. Plan: threshold-based rollback + circuit-breaker. Will propose defaults for 95p latency and error-rate spikes. :+1:

jordan (runtime): Noted recurring pattern: small canaries still caused memory-pressure regressions last two incidents. We should add resource-guard checks during canary (heap+rss).

mike (eng): I can take the resource-guard check integration. ETA: PR by EOW if nobody objects.

liz (sre): Also want an emergency kill-switch route that ops can flip without deployment. Ownership? I can own runbook and access.

tom (product): We should balance safety defaults with PLG — don't make canaries so strict they block everything. Suggest configurable policy per-release type.

sam (platform): Agree. Proposal sketch below:
```yaml
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  window: 5m
  error_rate_threshold: 3%
  p95_latency_increase: 30%
  resource_pressure: rss>80%
  sample_rate: 10%
```
This would be the org default; teams can opt-in/out with stricter or looser values.

jordan (runtime): For resource_pressure detection we need runtime hooks to report container RSS + lookback. I'll add metrics and an alert.

mike (eng): Opening PR: will add the runtime hook + test harness. Link when ready.

anya (oncall): Concrete action items:
- sam: draft policy + RFC (owner) — due 2026-03-31
- mike: runtime hooks PR + tests (owner) — due 2026-03-29
- liz: kill-switch runbook + access controls (owner) — due 2026-03-28
- jordan: canary resource metrics and dashboards (owner) — due 2026-04-02
- tom: config UX + opt-in model (owner) — due 2026-04-05
Please add if I'm missing anything.

deploy-bot: deploy status: canary-v3 started at 1945000360 — 10% traffic. No errors reported.

sam (platform): One more: automatic rollback must be auditable — write audit events and a Slack notice. I'll add event schema.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem page updated: https://redwood.company/postmortems/rollout-2026-03-24 — action items appended.

tom (product): Also request for a fortnightly canary pattern review — recurring incidents suggest we should review sampling strategy monthly. I'll schedule.

liz (sre): Quick ask: can we add a short test to CI that simulates increased latency in canary path to validate rollback trigger? I can help design it.

mike (eng): Yep, will add integration testing scenario to the PR.

anya (oncall): Great — I'll create a GH issue that lists these owners/timelines and link the RFCs/PRs. Folks please update status there so we can close action items in 2 weeks. :calendar:

sam (platform): Thanks. I'll ping tomorrow with the RFC draft.

jordan (runtime): Noted. If we spot divergences in the first rollouts after changes, we revert to manual gating until stable.

anya (oncall): Closing loop: owners, timelines, and next review on 2026-04-07. If anything slips, flag in the issue with a new ETA.

mike (eng): Ack.

liz (sre): Ack.
